events.title: Houthis claim strikes on Saudi Shaybah oilfield, Aramco Yanbu site and Riyadh and Abha airports
events.summary: Yemen's Houthis said they attacked Saudi energy, airport and military targets including the Shaybah oilfield, an Aramco site in Yanbu, King Khalid airport in Riyadh and Abha airport; Saudi damage was not confirmed in the report.

events.title: Ukraine launches more than 1,000 drones at Russia, setting St Petersburg oil terminal and depot ablaze
events.summary: Russia's defence ministry said it downed about 1,015 Ukrainian drones overnight, one of the largest attacks of the war; fires hit the St Petersburg oil terminal, the Ruchyi oil depot and a VK data centre, with one person killed. Russia answered with about 300 drones.

events.title: Zelensky says Russian forces attacked more than 15 energy facilities
events.summary: President Zelensky said Russian forces attacked more than 15 Ukrainian energy facilities in the latest strikes, as Russia keeps targeting the grid ahead of winter.

events.title: IRGC says a second supertanker hit a naval mine in Hormuz and declares the strait closed
events.summary: Iran's IRGC said a second supertanker struck a naval mine on an unauthorized Strait of Hormuz route and declared the strait closed after the tanker hits; the vessels were not identified and the US says the strait is under US and partner control. The claims are unverified.

events.title: Russian attacks kill eight in Ukraine and cut power to over a million
events.summary: Reuters reports Russian strikes killed eight people in Ukraine on Friday and left more than a million consumers without power, extending the campaign against the energy grid.

events.title: NBC: attacks on ships around the Strait of Hormuz reach record highs as Iran steps up strikes
events.summary: NBC News reported attacks on vessels around Hormuz have reached record levels with little US response; Reuters-cited tracking had already counted at least 12 tanker attacks in the week to Oct 5, the most since the war began.

events.title: European gas prices rise even as oil retreats
events.summary: European TTF gas prices rose on Monday while crude fell on the US waiver of Russia oil sanctions.

events.title: UKMTO: tanker hit by unidentified projectile northeast of Saudi Arabia's Jubail
events.summary: UKMTO reported a tanker was struck by an unidentified projectile northeast of Jubail on Friday; the crew was safe and evacuated. It extends Gulf shipping attacks beyond the Strait of Hormuz into Saudi waters.

events.title: Japan power price hits four-year high on rising coal and LNG costs
events.summary: Japanese wholesale power prices reached a four-year high as coal and LNG import costs rose.

events.title: IRGC says a supertanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine on an 'unauthorized' Hormuz route
events.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said an oil tanker ignited after striking a naval mine while using what they called an unauthorized route through the Strait of Hormuz; the vessel was not identified and the claim was not independently verified. It follows similar IRGC claims on Oct 10 (supertanker) and Oct 14 (container ship).

events.title: Russian strike kills six in Kharkiv region as Zelensky says US is delaying 'vital supplies'
events.summary: Ukraine said a Russian attack killed six people at a park in the Kharkiv region, including three children; Zelensky said Russia struck without warning from partners and the US was delaying vital supplies.

events.title: Ukrainian drones hit Surgut condensate plant in Russia's largest oil-producing region
events.summary: A suspected Ukrainian drone attack started a fire at an industrial facility in the Surgut district of Khanty-Mansi, identified by residents as Gazprom Pererabotka's Surgut Condensate Stabilization Plant, Russia's largest such facility; it appears to be the first strike on energy infrastructure in the region, and Surgut and Kogalym airports were restricted.

events.title: Indian official says crude tanker targeted by missile in Strait of Hormuz
events.summary: An Indian shipping official said a crude oil tanker was targeted by a missile in the Strait of Hormuz on Friday and also referred to the recent Romania-linked tanker incident; it adds to this week's string of attacks on Gulf shipping.

events.title: Tasnim: Yemeni drone attacks on Dammam halt airport activity
events.summary: Iran's Tasnim News reported Yemeni drone attacks on Dammam in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province and said activity at Dammam airport was halted; not independently confirmed.

events.title: Iran says US forces attacked Konark naval base; US official calls claim inaccurate
events.summary: Iran's navy said US forces attacked the Konark naval base in the morning, firing at a 35 mm cannon; a US official told CNN the claim was inaccurate.

events.title: Iranian supreme leader's adviser calls claims that Hormuz is open 'baseless'
events.summary: An adviser to Iran's supreme leader told Tasnim the claim that the Strait of Hormuz is open is baseless.

events.title: Zelensky offers to halt strikes on Russian refineries in exchange for more Patriot missiles
events.summary: Zelensky said Ukraine could stop striking Russian refineries if it received more US Patriot interceptors, calling that the minimum acceptable; Ukraine resumed refinery strikes on October 15.

events.title: Saudi Arabia to postpone in-person 'Davos in the Desert' after Houthi attacks
events.summary: The FT reported Saudi Arabia will postpone the in-person Future Investment Initiative after Houthi attacks; Fars separately reported sirens and an explosion in Riyadh the same hour.

events.title: Europe's gas prices near 2022 high as Hormuz LNG flows remain limited
events.summary: OilPrice.com reported European gas prices close to their highest since 2022 as LNG flows through the Strait of Hormuz remain limited.

events.title: Massive overnight Russian attack leaves over half a million Ukrainians without power
events.summary: Zelensky said a large overnight Russian missile and drone attack on energy infrastructure left more than 500,000 Ukrainians without electricity.

events.title: Rubio says Trump's Russia sanctions waiver is a 60-day pause to analyse economic impact
events.summary: Secretary of State Rubio described the waiver of new Russia sanctions and energy-linked duties under the Graham Act as a 60-day pause to assess the economic impact, The Guardian reports. Search did not confirm the 60-day framing.

events.title: Woodside natural gas project unit paused after Greenpeace protest off Western Australia
events.summary: Reuters reports Woodside paused a unit at one of its natural gas projects off Western Australia after a Greenpeace protest. Duration and which facility were not confirmed by search.

events.title: NYT: US floats allowing more Russian gas sales to Europe
events.summary: The New York Times reports the US is floating a step that would allow more Russian gas sales to Europe, a day after Trump waived sanctions and duties under the Graham Act; the EU plans to end Russian gas imports by end-2027.

events.title: Europe's LNG imports fall 13% to 21.52 million tonnes in Q3 2026
events.summary: Europe imported 21.52 million tonnes of LNG in the third quarter, down 13%, as cargoes shifted to Asia during the Middle East war, Egypt Oil & Gas reports.

events.title: Nigeria's NNPC responds to a gas pipeline explosion
events.summary: Bloomberg reported Nigerian National Petroleum Co. is responding to an explosion on a gas pipeline; extent of supply disruption not yet reported.

events.title: Europe's mild winter outlook tests natural gas preparedness
events.summary: Industrial Info Resources says forecasts for a mild European winter are shaping gas storage and supply planning as the region heads into heating season.

episodes.t: India Diet Coke and canned beer shortage
episodes.lesson: Owning the raw material (bauxite) does not help if the mid-chain step (can sheet) is imported.
m: Can stock from the UAE and Saudi cut; domestic capacity already 20% short
Coca-Cola rationed Diet Coke; Blinkit capped orders at 4 cans

episodes.t: Iran strikes EGA and Alba smelters
episodes.lesson: Energy-rich producers can become war targets.

episodes.t: Trump post delays strikes on Iranian energy
episodes.lesson: Words move prices for minutes; the move reversed when Iran denied talks.
m: S&P futures rose about 240 points in six minutes

episodes.t: Strikes on Qatar’s Ras Laffan LNG (mid-March)
episodes.lesson: Repair time, not the headline, sets how long a price stays high.
m: TTF jumped up to 35% at the open; 2 of 14 trains out for 3–5 years
Gas feedstock for Gulf fertiliser lost
